newsitem.title: USA: Harnischfeger says committed to Giddings effort.
newsitem.headline: Harnischfeger says committed to Giddings effort.

text.p: Harnischfeger Industries Inc said it is committed to its effort to acquire Giddings & Lewis Inc, which rejected a $19 per share tender offer from Harnischfeger as inadequate.

"Harnischfeger is fully committed to bringing about a strategic business combination of our two companies, with the integration of G&L into our business as a key element of our industrial products and services strategy," said chairman and chief executive Jeffery Grade.

On May 15, Harnischfeger said it filed a definitive solicitation statement with the U.S. Securities & Exchange Commission as part of its effort unseat the Giddings board by calling a special meeting of shareholders.
